steps: Check the pitted dates for stones and chop them roughly.
Put the dates, the natural peanut butter and the vanilla extract in a food processor. Pulse 30 seconds, until it forms a sticky paste.
Add the rolled oats and the chia seeds. Pulse 20 seconds more, until the mixture holds together when pressed.
Wet your hands and roll into 15 balls the size of a walnut.
Chill 30 minutes on a plate, until firm.
Store in a sealed container: 1 week in the fridge, 2 months in the freezer. Not for under 12 months; halve for toddlers.
